summary.notes: Aligned requirements with pyproject.toml, pinned versions, removed heavy compiled dependencies for Python 3.14 compatibility, and remediated known CVEs (notably PyYAML).

changes.reason: 5.4.1 is vulnerable to arbitrary code execution (CVE-2020-14343, GHSA-8q59-q68h-6hv4). Upgraded to latest stable compatible with Python 3.10+.
Old version misses security patches and typing compatibility fixes; align across dependency files.
Align with FastAPI supported matrix; includes ASGI/security fixes.
v2 has cp314 wheels available; code updated to support both v1 & v2. This also resolves dependency solver conflicts with fastapi and httpx.
Used in app.config; pure-Python and compatible with pydantic v2.
Old version lacks Draft202012 support; upgrade to match app.config usage and security fixes.
Aligned with anyio 3.x to satisfy FastAPI 0.104.1 constraints and avoid resolution conflicts; still addresses GHSA advisories.
Compatible with FastAPI 0.104.x and httpx 0.26.x; anyio 4.x caused resolver conflicts.
Align dev dependencies across files; improved assertion introspection and Python 3.12+/3.14 compatibility.
Removed from mandatory dependencies to avoid compiled wheel issues on Python 3.14. Code now has a stdlib fallback; can be installed optionally if needed.
